subQuests.subQuestName: Ascend the summit of Mt. Laixin

711270402.text: Huh? Lingyuan? Why are you over here?

711270404.text: Can't get in? Uh, where can't you get into?

711270405.text: Carp's Rest. Where Fujin is resting.

711270406.text: Carp's Rest... Oh! You mean the place Fujin dragged us off to way back when?

711270407.text: It is an abode sealed by her adeptal energy. I don't have her adeptal energy. Thus, I cannot go to her.

711270408.text: Huh? But you didn't mention anything before she went back to rest...

711270411.text: The adeptal energy you possess is sufficient to open the gate of Carp's Rest. So yes, I need your help.

711270416.text: Huh? Wait a sec, so you've been waiting here for us this whole time?

711270417.text: I was not waiting for you. I was looking for a way into Carp's Rest.

711270418.text: That seems like pretty much the same thing to... Uh, anyway, we're a bit worried about Fujin's condition too, so why don't we go see her together?

711270413.text: Yeah, how could you forget something as important as that!? Really, now.

711270414.text: It is because I am a slow-witted beast. Seeing her, I think of many things, and forget many things. It is my fault.

711270415.text: The adeptal energy you possess is sufficient to open the gate of Carp's Rest. So yes, I need your help.

711270301.text: Speaking of which, this should be your abode, right, Fujin? It feels a bit different from the other adeptal abodes we've been in... How should Paimon put it... it feels more... pragmatic?

711270302.text: There are no weird mechanisms or transparent floating bridges...

711270303.text: I am very sorry... I was just too embarrassed before, and so never explained clearly.

711270304.text: I cannot create new adeptal realms like the adepti of the south. "Carp's Rest" is no "abode." At best, it's just a "cave"...

711270305.text: Cave, realm, whatever! They're all "abodes" where adepti live, aren't they? Still, we don't even know when you can turn back into your human form...

711270306.text: All the power she accumulated has dispersed across this land. She will be unable to revert to human form for some time.

711270307.text: I am the same way when I've exhausted my power. After Master died, the snow fell, melted, and then it fell once more after melting, and did so countless times before I could regain human form.

711270308.text: Oh, so that's it... huh? Wait a sec, Lingyuan, you can turn into a person too!?

711270309.text: Why, of course! There is much you two know not! Why, back then, on Mt. Yaojun, Lingyuan's looks were—

711270310.text: Fujin. No need to speak of such things. It has nothing to do with the present topic.

711270311.text: Eh? So, the whole thing about eating too many teacakes at the temple fair in human form, and crying to Herblord about brewing weight-loss tea...

711270312.text: Or the incident where you accidentally drank the celebratory libations and hauled forest boars in to ask them "Who's prettier, me or Herblord?"... Ah! But I needn't speak of such things after all, do I?

711270314.text: Wow! After all that, Paimon's getting curious. What does your human form look like, Lingyuan? Would you be as blue as you are now? Or would you be... Uh, a slightly lighter shade?

711270316.text: I do not understand your curiosity. You are people too. If you are interested in human forms, just look at yourselves.

711270321.text: #Hehe... Anyway, thank you, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. I never imagined the day would come when I would be able to talk to others like this...

711270322.text: *cough*— As one has found oneself in such a joyous state of mind, one is willing to bestow protection upon you two for your journey, guaranteeing success and great fortune...

711270324.text: ...Sorry, I got a bit carried away. I wanted to try being like those adepti, so I thought I'd try out a phrase or two...

711270325.text: Anyway! I'll be staying here and praying for your journey to go smoothly.

711270318.text: I refuse. Human bodies are weak. They lack fangs to rend and rip prey, and claws to hound and hunt enemies. I would not do such a thing unless commanded to by Fujin.

711270319.text: ...Eh? R—Really? I—In that case, I think maybe we should just respect Lingyuan's wishes...?

711270320.text: I do not have any wishes. If you have some, tell me so directly.

711270501.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Lingyuan... Why did you all come here?

711270502.text: Whoa, that's Fujin's voice! And it's... coming from down below?

711270504.text: Yeah! We're all worried about your health, so we just came here without giving you a heads up — you did the same thing to us first, so Paimon thinks we're square now!

711270509.text: Huh? Ah! Sorry! When I returned here to rest, I think I forgot to unlock the entrance...! I am so sorry. You came here to see me, but I made things harder for you instead...

711270510.text: Oh, it wasn't much of a hassle! But why are you... uh, hiding in a puddle?

711270511.text: Hmm, how should I put it...? Because I can't return to the form I prefer yet, and with you guys always seeing me in my Carp form, I can't help but feel a bit... embarrassed...

711270508.text: Yeah! Lingyuan's been so worried about your health that she can barely speak, so we just came here without giving you a heads up — but you did the same thing to us first, so Paimon thinks we're square now!

711270901.text: Bluey, Bluey, you didn't tell me the ending to that story you were telling me last time!

711270902.text: Yes. I remember. However, I've changed my mind.

711270903.text: "Changed your mind"? What's that supposed to mean?

711270904.text: I'll leave the ending of the story... to you.

711270905.text: Ehhh!? C'mon, Bluey, that's cheating! You promised that you'd tell me a story if I told you one! How come I'm the one telling both stories now!?

711270906.text: I'm just a simple-minded beast. I cannot think of a good ending.

711270907.text: The ending I came up with was a bad ending. The story is also a bad story that wouldn't make anyone happy. So, I'll let you tell the ending of the story.

711270909.text: I do not deny that. As compensation, I can take you to see the hidden sights of Mt. Lingmeng.

711270911.text: Don't make that face. I will give you special permission to... Sit on my back, for five minutes or so. Ten minutes will do, too.

711270912.text: In... In that case, then it's a deal! I'll think of an ending for the story...

711271003.text: Ah, sorry! Are you hunting? Did we disturb you?

711271004.text: I was not hunting. You did not disturb me either.

711271005.text: Uh... Then were you just... spacing out? Like, thinking about tasty food and stuff?

711271006.text: I wasn't thinking about you either. I was just thinking.

711271007.text: Thinking... Hang on, wait! What did you mean by that first part!?

711271008.text: #I am thinking about the question {NICKNAME} asked before.

711271009.text: "If human activities are part of the laws of nature, how would you view humanity?"

711271010.text: It has been too long since I last had contact with the humans constituting the settlement — I have not been there since Fujin and the snake left.

711271011.text: Hey, you're making it sound like Little Mao doesn't count as a human!

711271012.text: #Little Mao is a human that belongs to the settled humans, but is not a human who constitutes the settlement. You and {NICKNAME} "constitute" travel companions, but you do not "belong" to {NICKNAME}. That is the difference.

711271014.text: Not in full. Most human young are like this until they are completely absorbed by the order, just as it is in nature.

711271017.text: It has been too long since I have been in contact with the humans who constitute the settlement. It could be because of hatred, fear, or maybe even both.

711271016.text: Hey! Don't say weird things like that!

711271101.text: Listening to Mountain, it sounds like Fontaine's operas are pretty similar to ours!

711271102.text: Knights, magicians, brave warriors, and evil dragons, you kill me, I kill you, and in the end, everyone's dead!

711271103.text: What's important isn't the ending! It's the process — how you get there! Not every tragedy can be seen as a mere sequence of fight scenes!

711271104.text: Oh, oh! And the "Ray-more-young Golems" Mountain was just talking about sound really, really cool too! I wonder if they're bigger than Bluey?

711271106.text: Oh, right! I never told you about Bluey, did I... How about this? You tell me more about "Ray-more-young Golems," and I'll tell you about Bluey!

711271202.text: What's wrong, Lingyuan? You keep staring at me. Do I have food on my face or something?

711271203.text: I was just thinking... No. It's nothing.

711271204.text: Even if you and the snake both asked me to, I will never again take human form.

711271205.text: Hehe. I haven't ever asked you to before, have I now?

711271206.text: ...Forget it. Let's go. Or did you not clamor to see the present tea garden?

711271301.text: Big Sis Fujin! Congratulations on returning to your former self!

711271302.text: Bluey already told me all about it! You really like tea, so I specially requested that Grandpa Lu make you a super-duper delicious teacake!

711271303.text: That's right, I'm back, completely and totally back! Little Mao, thank you so much for preparing a teacake just for me, I'm so happy!

711271304.text: There's some for you two, too! We can all eat teacakes together and celebrate Fujin's recovery!

711271306.text: Hehe, thanks, Little Mao! Since there's so much left, Paimon will take two pieces!

711271308.text: Hehe, thanks, Little Mao! Since that's the case, Paimon will take two... too? Waaah! There's only one piece left!
